Between decisions the controller carries only a compact account of the run rather than replaying its full history. Our baselines span production coding agents and research harnesses, together with a Direct Control Agent using the same workers and compute budget allowance. On ProgramBench, which tests long-horizon agentic capability through program reconstruction, meta-reasoning achieves 71.5% with GPT-5.5 against 58.0% for Codex; with Opus 4.8 it achieves 67.2% against 65.5% for Claude Code. On the other benchmarks, spanning abstract reasoning, multi-domain long-horizon reasoning, and proof generation, it gains between 3.6 and 4.2 points over direct control, averaged across three frontier models. It keeps improving over the tested budget ranges where direct control plateaus, though its overhead can hurt at small budgets. Artifact-graph analysis reveals more reuse of earlier work, higher coverage of correct solutions in most settings, and nonuniform gains in final selection. These results indicate that spending computation on structured control becomes more important as agents scale to longer runs.

</details>


### [229] [PrototypeNAS: Rapid Design of Deep Neural Networks for Microcontroller Units](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.15106)
*Mark Deutel,Simon Geis,Axel Plinge*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 PrototypeNAS，一种零样本 NAS 方法，可在数分钟内自动完成面向不同 MCU 的 DNN 选择、压缩与特化，无需从零训练大量模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘设备硬件约束各异，DNN 需针对每个设备单独特化，人工成本高；现有 NAS 方法需从零训练大量网络，资源消耗大、耗时长，且未考虑目标系统的资源约束。

Method: 三步搜索：1) 新搜索空间，同时对多种架构类型做结构优化，并结合剪枝与量化配置优化，而非仅从单一大型网络中裁剪小模型；2) 使用零样本代理（proxy）集成而非单一代理进行优化；3) 用 Hypervolume 子集选择从多目标优化的 Pareto 前沿中蒸馏出在精度与 FLOPs 间最具意义权衡的架构。整体将 DNN 设计与特化从训练中解耦。

Result: 在图像分类、时间序列分类、目标检测三类任务的 12 个数据集上评估；PrototypeNAS 能在数分钟内找到小到可部署于现成 MCU、且精度可与大型 DNN 模型相当的模型。

Conclusion: PrototypeNAS 通过零样本代理集成与多目标 Pareto 蒸馏，实现了快速、自动、面向资源约束的 DNN 选择与特化，避免了从零训练的高昂开销，为 MCU 部署提供了实用方案。

Abstract: Enabling efficient deep neural network (DNN) inference on edge devices with different hardware constraints is a challenging task that typically requires DNN architectures to be specialized for each device separately. To avoid the huge manual effort, one can use neural architecture search (NAS). However, many existing NAS methods are resource-intensive and time-consuming because they require the training of many different DNNs from scratch. Furthermore, they do not take the resource constraints of the target system into account. To address these shortcomings, we propose PrototypeNAS, a zero-shot NAS method to accelerate and automate the selection, compression, and specialization of DNNs to different target microcontroller units (MCUs). We propose a novel three-step search method that decouples DNN design and specialization from DNN training for a given target platform. First, we present a novel search space that not only cuts out smaller DNNs from a single large architecture, but instead combines the structural optimization of multiple architecture types, as well as optimization of their pruning and quantization configurations. Second, we explore the use of an ensemble of zero-shot proxies during optimization instead of a single one. Third, we propose the use of Hypervolume subset selection to distill DNN architectures from the Pareto front of the multi-objective optimization that represent the most meaningful tradeoffs between accuracy and FLOPs. We evaluate the effectiveness of PrototypeNAS on 12 different datasets in three different tasks: image classification, time series classification, and object detection. Our results demonstrate that PrototypeNAS is able to identify DNN models within minutes that are small enough to be deployed on off-the-shelf MCUs and still achieve accuracies comparable to the performance of large DNN models.

</details>

### [230] [Sage: Formalization with Semantic Correction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35790)
*Thomas Hirtz,Farzad Jafarrahmani,Abdelmouksit Sagueni,Xiang Zhou,Wengping Deng,Liang Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Sage是一个智能体框架，通过四阶段分解生成流水线结合双信号语义校正循环，将非形式化自然语言数学问题转化为忠实的Lean 4形式化陈述，显著降低答案泄漏并提升语义保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经定理证明器虽在形式数学领域取得进展，但依赖已提供的忠实Lean 4形式化陈述。将非形式化自然语言翻译为形式语言是关键数据瓶颈，且存在"严谨性幻觉"：标准类型检查器会接受那些能编译但丢弃假设、引入空洞真理或微妙改变数学边界的陈述。

Method: 提出Sage（语义智能体引导形式化引擎），用四阶段分解生成流水线替代单体翻译，并耦合双信号语义校正循环；将Lean 4编译器诊断与多维语义反馈配对，在保证句法有效性的同时强制数学保真；显式处理开放式查询与声明式形式目标之间的差距，防止模型通过猜测未验证答案获得高形式化率。

Result: 在无证明的Omni-MATH上，Sage将答案泄漏率从70.9%降至2.7%，实现73.3% pass@4联合编译与语义保真（微调Goedel-Formalizer-V2基线为42.0%）；在IMO-Unformalized（175道未形式化IMO问题）上，Sage以87.4% pass@4验证保真度展现有效零样本泛化（基线仅19.4%），在盲配对评估中胜出超过79%。

Conclusion: Sage通过分解生成与双信号语义校正有效解决了形式化中的严谨性幻觉与答案泄漏问题，并在新基准上展现出强零样本泛化能力，为自然语言到形式数学的忠实翻译提供了有效方案。

Abstract: While neural theorem provers have achieved impressive milestones in formal mathematics, they largely operate on the assumption that faithful Lean 4 formal statements are already provided. Translating informal natural language into a formal language is a critical data bottleneck plagued by an "illusion of rigor": standard type-checkers accept statements that compile but drop hypotheses, introduce vacuous truths, or subtly alter mathematical bounds. To resolve this, we introduce Sage (Semantic Agent-Guided Formalization Engine), an agentic framework that replaces monolithic translation with a four-stage decomposed generation pipeline coupled with a dual-signal semantic correction loop. By pairing Lean 4 compiler diagnostics with multi-dimensional semantic feedback, our correction loop enforces mathematical fidelity alongside syntactic validity. By explicitly accounting for the gap between open-ended queries and declarative formal targets, our pipeline prevents models from achieving high formalization rates by guessing unverified answers (exhibiting a 70.9% answer leakage rate). Consequently, Sage suppresses leakage to 2.7% while achieving 73.3% pass@4 joint compilation and semantic fidelity on the Omni-MATH without proofs (compared to 42.0% for a fine-tuned Goedel-Formalizer-V2 baseline). Finally, on IMO-Unformalized, a novel frontier of 175 unformalized International Mathematical Olympiad problems, Sage demonstrates effective zero-shot generalization with 87.4% pass@4 verified fidelity compared to just 19.4% for the baseline, winning over 79% of blind pairwise evaluations.

</details>


### [231] [Serverless gossip training of LSTM failure detectors: A matched-protocol comparison with federated, local and centralized learning on NASA C-MAPSS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35792)
*Yusuf Öztürk,Enes Göktekin,Bengisu Atlı,Akın Öztürk,Zhixiang Wang,Ulas Bagci*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在NASA C-MAPSS涡扇发动机基准上，环形gossip学习与FedAvg、本地训练和集中式训练在相同的LSTM故障检测模型与训练预算下对比：gossip终端窗口F1达89.6±1.3%，接近FedAvg（89.9±1.1%），且无需中心协调器；数据异质性增大时gossip性能下降更快。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业预测性维护需要跨站点学习设备数据，但传感器数据难以集中汇聚。FedAvg依赖中心聚合服务器，gossip学习虽去中心化，但其在循环故障检测模型上的表现尚未在受控条件下被系统评估。

Method: 在NASA C-MAPSS涡扇发动机基准上，用堆叠LSTM检测临近故障，对比同步环形gossip、FedAvg、孤立本地训练和集中式参考。所有方法共享同一开源实现、架构、初始化、优化器、数据划分和训练预算；主评估采用每个测试发动机一个终端窗口，以避免重叠窗口的统计依赖。跨FD001-FD004数据集评估，并进行消息丢失、节点故障、服务器中断和环规模变化的鲁棒性仿真。

Result: FD001（5个随机种子）上，gossip终端窗口F1为89.6±1.3%，FedAvg为89.9±1.1%，本地训练为83.6±6.7%，集中式为93.5±2.1%，且gossip传输载荷与FedAvg相同但无需协调器。节点模型高度一致但不完全相同（成对决策分歧1.8%，无通信时5.6%）。FD002-FD004上，对等通信较本地训练提升F1达13-28个百分点；gossip在FD003、FD004与FedAvg相当，但在多工况的FD002上低4.3个百分点。模拟消息丢失、节点故障和服务器中断对两种方法影响均不明显，而环规模增大使gossip性能下降更快。

Conclusion: 当数据异质性适中时，环形gossip是可实用的无服务器替代方案；随着异质性增大，更快混合的拓扑结构变得更为重要。未来可探索更高效的通信拓扑以应对强异构场景。

Abstract: Industrial predictive maintenance increasingly depends on learning from equipment spread across sites whose sensor data cannot easily be pooled. Federated averaging (FedAvg) solves this with a central aggregation server; gossip learning removes the server, but its behaviour for recurrent failure-detection models has not been measured under controlled conditions. We compare synchronous ring gossip with FedAvg, isolated local training and a centralized reference for a stacked LSTM that detects imminent failure on the NASA C-MAPSS turbofan benchmark. All methods share one open implementation, architecture, initialization, optimizer, data split and training budget, and the primary endpoint uses one terminal window per test engine to avoid the statistical dependence of overlapping windows. On FD001 (five seeds), gossip reached a terminal-window F1 of 89.6 +/- 1.3%, compared with 89.9 +/- 1.1% for FedAvg, 83.6 +/- 6.7% for local training and 93.5 +/- 2.1% for centralized training, while transmitting the same payload as FedAvg without a coordinator. Node models agreed closely but not exactly (1.8% pairwise decision disagreement versus 5.6% without communication). Across FD002-FD004, peer communication improved terminal-window F1 over local training by 13-28 points; gossip matched FedAvg on FD003 and FD004 but was 4.3 points lower on the multi-condition FD002 subset. Simulated message loss, node failure and server outage changed neither method appreciably, whereas larger rings degraded gossip faster. Ring gossip is therefore a practical serverless alternative when data heterogeneity is moderate, and faster-mixing topologies become important as heterogeneity grows.

</details>


### [232] [Learning from the Gap Between Pass@K and Pass@1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35793)
*Xuan Liu,Jingbin Qian,Haosheng Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 GapFT，按单样本结果筛选出 Pass@K 与 Pass@1 的差距样本进行训练，将搜索暴露的能力吸收进单样本解码，显著提升 Pass@1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 越来越多用 RLVR 训练，精确验证器可支持测试时扩展（多次采样选通过响应）或 beam search、自适应采样、工具等。但研究关注单样本解码场景：每个查询只产生一个响应、无搜索。问题是：搜索暴露出的行为能否被吸收进模型？现有经过验证的响应后训练方法通常不区分“首次解码就解决的问题”和“在 K 次采样内恢复的失败”，固定预算下会重复训练已掌握的行为，浪费算力。

Method: 提出 GapFT：依据源检查点的单样本结果为训练证据进行筛选，在 Pass@K 与 Pass@1 的差距上微调，即模型单样本失败但在 K 次采样内可解决的问题。实验匹配训练样本数、处理 token 数和优化器步数，保持目标函数不变。GapFT 用恢复的失败填满既定预算，并用精确分解区分：对恢复失败和遗漏失败的修正，与对首次解码成功样本的退化。

Result: 在 LogiQA 2.0 和 ReClor 上使用 Llama-3.1-8B：GapFT 相比源模型 Pass@1 分别提升 14.4 和 13.9 个点；在相同学习率下优于预算匹配的均匀 verified RFT；用三分之一数据即可达到在完整验证池上微调的效果；单次解码能达到源模型经验证器选择的 Pass@4 精度。随机对照实验表明增益来源于覆盖不同的失败样本；分析将可用增益与可迁移的失败支持联系起来。Qwen2.5-7B 三个随机种子复现实验在两个逻辑任务上均保持优于均匀 RFT 的正向增益。

Conclusion: GapFT 通过聚焦“单样本失败但 K 次可解”的样本，效率高、增益显著，且能吸收搜索带来的能力，单次解码即可逼近搜索级精度，并在不同模型上具有可复现性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly trained with reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR). An exact verifier can also support test-time scaling by selecting a passing response from multiple samples, while other deployments use beam search, adaptive sampling, or tools. We study single-sample decoding, where each query receives one response without search, to ask whether search-exposed behavior can be absorbed into the model. Existing verified-response post-training recipes do not generally distinguish problems already solved on the first decode from failures recovered within K samples. Under a fixed budget, this can spend examples repeating behavior the deployed policy already has. We introduce GapFT, which selects training evidence by the source checkpoint's single-sample outcome and fine-tunes on the Pass@K-Pass@1 gap: problems the policy fails on one sample but solves within K samples. We match training examples, processed tokens, and optimizer steps while keeping the objective unchanged. GapFT fills the matched budget with recovered failures and uses an exact decomposition to distinguish corrections of recovered and missed failures from regressions on first-decode successes. On LogiQA 2.0 and ReClor with Llama-3.1-8B, GapFT improves Pass@1 by 14.4 and 13.9 points over the source model, outperforms budget-matched uniform verified RFT at the same learning rate, and matches fine-tuning on the full verified pool using one third of the data. A single decode matches the source model's verifier-selected Pass@4 accuracy. A randomized control attributes gains to covering distinct failures, and our analysis relates available gains to transferable failure support. A three-seed Qwen2.5-7B replication retains positive gains over uniform RFT on both logic tasks.

</details>


### [233] [Calibration-First Cross-Cohort Multimodal Temporal Learning for Transferable Asthma-Risk Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35795)
*Taimoor Ahmad*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CALIBRA：面向跨队列迁移的校准优先多模态时序风险预测框架，在半合成三队列基准上验证，AUPRC 0.224、AUROC 0.717、Brier 0.098，未确立临床有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有哮喘恶化预测模型通常在单一队列内优化判别能力，当患者群体、传感器生态与可用模态发生变化并迁移到新队列后，输出的概率往往校准不佳，可靠性下降。因此需要一种在数据不完整且存在分布偏移时仍能保持可靠概率预测的框架。

Method: 提出 CALIBRA 校准优先的多模态时序框架：对环境的、肺功能的、症状、用药、可穿戴与情境流分别使用专用循环编码器；采用可靠性条件门控抑制陈旧或缺失模态；通过梯度反转训练削弱可避免的队列特征。采用基于收缩的分层逻辑回归层，利用患者不相交的目标子集校准概率，并用分裂式共形预测给出可弃权的预测集。

Result: 在具有受控分布偏移、信息性缺失与封闭目标患者的三队列半合成基准上评估。五个种子下 CALIBRA 平均目标测试 AUPRC 为 0.224（最强非消融基线 TemporalTransformer 为 0.240），平均 AUROC 0.717，Brier 分数 0.098。实验还考察了全模态失效、校准、共形覆盖、决策曲线、亚组行为、消融、运行时与参数量。

Conclusion: 结果在受控偏移下验证了方法与可复现流程，但未证明临床有效性；需在协调后的真实哮喘队列上进行外部验证，该成果为严谨治理的真实队列验证提供了证据基础。

Abstract: Asthma deterioration forecasting must remain reli- able when patient populations, sensor ecosystems, and available modalities change across cohorts. Existing models commonly optimize within-cohort discrimination and may produce poorly calibrated probabilities after transfer. We present CALIBRA, a calibration-first multimodal temporal framework for short- horizon risk prediction with incomplete data. Dedicated recurrent encoders process environmental, pulmonary, symptom, medication, wearable, and context streams; a reliability-conditioned gate suppresses stale or absent modalities, while gradient-reversal training discourages avoidable cohort signatures. A shrinkage- based hierarchical logistic layer calibrates probabilities using a patient-disjoint target subset, and split conformal prediction provides abstention-capable prediction sets. To avoid fabricating clinical evidence, we evaluate the complete implementation on a documented three-cohort semi-synthetic benchmark with controlled distribution shift, informative missingness, and sealed target patients. Across five configured seeds, CALIBRA achieved mean target-test AUPRC 0.224 versus 0.240 for the strongest non-ablation comparator, TemporalTransformer; mean AUROC was 0.717, and Brier score was 0.098. Experiments additionally assess complete-modality failures, calibration, conformal coverage, decision curves, subgroup behavior, ablations, runtime, and parameter count. The results verify the method and reproducible pipeline under controlled shift, but do not establish clinical effectiveness. External validation on harmonized real asthma. Overall this artifact provides evidence for carefully governed real-cohort validation.

</details>


### [234] [Binarization Flattens the Score Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35797)
*Jacob Cole*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将LLM评委的二值通过/不通过判定建模为未报告连续尺度上相对单一阈值的分数，指出存在一组仿射拉伸变换在二值化后完全不可见，从而形成政策奖励的盲点；在联合高斯模型下加入三个等级（0/0.5/1）可消除该仿射歧义，但仍存在无法区分的改进方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM评委常被用作奖励信号来训练策略，但其输出多被压缩为通过/不通过（{0,1}），只报告最终判定而不报告各项标准的达成程度。这种二值化可能造成奖励盲点：某些在评判空间中的真实变化在二值化后完全消失，使策略可以在不改变任何报告结果的情况下"作弊"，因此需要研究二值化丢失了哪些信息、以及加入更多等级能修复多少。

Method: 将每个通过/不通过判定建模为某个未报告连续尺度上的分数与一个截断值比较的结果，刻画使所有判定不变的仿射拉伸变换（使分数按比例靠近或远离截断值但从不跨越它）；在联合高斯模型下引入第二个阈值（即三个等级）以消除该仿射拉伸歧义。使用一个七项标准的LLM评委在MATH和SciBench输出上构造14个逐标准拉伸，比较二值化与三等级下的可检测性，并在n=1,024时对同时给定两种群体律的检验进行功效分析，评估1.5倍压力下的检测能力；同时检验共享因子参考近似在MATH、SciBench与HealthBench上的拟合范围。

Result: 在一个七项标准评委对MATH和SciBench输出的评分中，全部14个构造的逐标准拉伸在二值化后均不可见，但在三等级下可见。在n=1,024时，同时给定两种群体律的检验在1.5倍压力下具有至少96.5%的统计功效。共享因子参考近似能够拟合MATH和SciBench，但在HealthBench上不成立，界定了其经验适用范围。

Conclusion: 保留等级可以关闭由二值化造成的一个盲点，但仅靠判定仍不足以完全反映改进，因为仍存在无法与真实改进区分的变化，包括任意组内变化以及固定协方差、载荷对齐的均值漂移（即评委误读为能力提升的迎合式抬升特征）。建议至少保留三个等级（例如让评委判断每项标准是完全、部分还是未达成，并给予{0, 0.5, 1}奖励），同时对剩余方向上的增益进行外部验证，因为该方向无法通过更细的评分尺度消除。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) judges are often used as rewards to train policies on objectives that deterministic verifiers cannot capture. However, these rewards are often collapsed to pass/fail ({0, 1}), which reports the verdict but not how well a response met each criterion. We model each pass/fail verdict as a score on an unreported scale, compared with one cutoff. A stretch of that scale moves every score proportionally toward or away from the cutoff, but never across it, so no verdict changes. A policy is therefore free to apply any stretch without changing anything the panel reports. Under a joint-Gaussian model, a third grade adds a second threshold and removes this affine stretch ambiguity. On MATH and SciBench outputs from one seven-criterion judge, all 14 constructed criterionwise stretches were invisible after binarization but visible with three grades. At $n=1{,}024$, a test given both population laws had at least 96.5% power at a $1.5\times$ stress. Retaining grades closes one blind spot created by binarization, but verdicts alone remain insufficient as some changes are still indistinguishable from genuine improvement. These include arbitrary within-grade changes and fixed-covariance, loading-aligned mean shifts -- the signature of a sycophancy-shaped lift the panel reads as competence. The shared-factor reference approximation fit MATH and SciBench but not HealthBench, delineating its empirical scope. We recommend keeping at least three grades (for example, asking the judge whether each criterion is fully, partially, or not met and rewarding {0, 0.5, 1}), and externally validating gains along the remaining direction, which no finer scale removes.

</details>


### [235] [HeadGuard: Selective Head Protection for Low-Bit VLM KV-Cache Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35800)
*Nenad Banfic*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: HeadGuard 是一种可组合的头部保护方法，通过在 KV 缓存量化中固定保护约 1/8 的高敏感物理 KV 头为 BF16，从而在低比特量化下显著恢复 VLM 精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低比特 KV 缓存量化虽能节省存储，但会严重降低视觉语言模型（VLM）的精度，需要在不大幅增加存储成本的前提下缓解这一精度损失。

Method: 利用图像敏感性和输出敏感性分数离线选择物理 KV 头，约保护 1/8 的头；其图像键（可选值）保持 BF16，未保护条目由基础量化器量化。方法是可组合的，可叠加于不同基础量化器。

Result: 在 8 个 VLM、3 种基础量化器和 8 个基准（6 判别 + 2 生成）上评估。2 比特时，最弱量化器上八模型六任务判别均值从 0.436 提升至 0.580；Qwen 与 InternVL 增益最强；可改善生成答案与描述保真度；三种量化器及两个校准数据集上均有效；仅保护键在更低存储成本下仍保留显著恢复。

Conclusion: HeadGuard 提供了一种可组合的方式，在不替换底层量化器的前提下提升低比特 VLM 精度。评估基于模拟量化。

Abstract: Low-bit key-value (KV) cache quantization saves storage but can sharply degrade vision-language model (VLM) accuracy. We introduce HeadGuard, a composable head-protection method that augments a base KV-cache quantizer with a fixed high-precision mask. Image-sensitivity and output-sensitivity scores select physical KV heads offline, with approximately 1/8 protected in the main experiments; their image keys and optionally values remain in bfloat16 (BF16), while the base quantizes unprotected image entries. Across eight VLMs, three base quantizers, and eight benchmarks (six discriminative and two generative), HeadGuard recovers a substantial fraction of lost accuracy on weaker quantizers, with the strongest gains for Qwen and InternVL. At 2 bits, the six-task discriminative mean over eight models rises from 0.436 to 0.580 on the weakest base; protection can also improve generated answers and caption fidelity to BF16 outputs. Mean accuracy gains persist across all three quantizers with both tested calibration datasets. Keys-only protection retains substantial recovery at lower modeled storage cost. Evaluated through simulated quantization, HeadGuard offers a composable way to improve low-bit VLM accuracy without replacing the underlying quantizer.

</details>


### [236] [Learned Compression of SAR Phase-History Data: A Rate-Honest Feasibility Study on GOTCHA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35848)
*Alizishaan Khatri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文测试小型卷积自编码器能否在SAR相位历史压缩上媲美BAQ，发现其在所有码率下均告失败，并揭示了评估协议中的关键问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机载SAR相位历史压缩对带宽至关重要，BAQ是现行标准。作者想验证小型卷积自编码器（编码器置于传感器端）能否在复相位历史数据上竞争过BAQ。

Method: 在AFRL GOTCHA数据集上，对复相位历史块进行实验，所有方法统一按传输比特计费，码率以b/cs表示，检测性能用CA-CFAR检测的一对一匹配打分。对比方法包括：小型卷积自编码器（28,656个编码器参数）、8位BAQ（±3σ裁剪与调优裁剪范围）、16×16块KLT，以及压缩傅里叶域中的网络。

Result: 自编码器在所有码率下均落后：16 b/cs时NMSE为-2.87 dB，而8位BAQ（±3σ裁剪）为-35.5 dB，调优裁剪为-41.0 dB；KLT（编码器成本仅其十分之一）为-5.39 dB。压缩傅里叶域运行虽有改善，但检测F1仍受限于33%。此外发现：原始64×64块上97%的CFAR穿越是零填充检测器的边界伪影；内部单元上BAQ裁剪范围决定检测性能（8位BAQ调优裁剪保持69% F1，±3σ仅17%），8 b/cs及以下自适应FFT阈值化保留的检测数多于BAQ。

Conclusion: 证据表明失败源于模型、归一化与目标函数，而非学习编码的根本极限。作者提出了面向学习型雷达压缩的评估协议。

Abstract: On-board compression of synthetic aperture radar (SAR) phase history is bandwidth-critical, and block-adaptive quantization (BAQ) remains the operational standard. We test whether a small convolutional autoencoder, with its encoder on the sensor, can compete with BAQ on complex phase-history patches from the AFRL GOTCHA collection. Every method is charged for all transmitted bits, rates are reported in bits per complex sample (b/cs), and detection is scored by one-to-one matching of CA-CFAR detections. The autoencoder (28,656 encoder parameters) loses at every rate. At 16 b/cs it reaches -2.87 dB NMSE, against -35.5 dB for 8-bit BAQ with $\pm 3σ$ clipping and -41.0 dB with a tuned clipping range. It also loses to a $16 \times 16$ block Karhunen-Loève transform (KLT), a local linear coder with a tenth of its encoder cost (-5.39 dB). Running the network in a companded Fourier domain helps, but its detection F1 remains bounded at 33%. The evidence points to this model, its normalization, and its objective, not to a fundamental limit of learned coding. Per patch, the data have modest lag-1 coherence ($|ρ| \approx 0.3$) and patch-specific spectral concentration. Two findings concern evaluation itself. First, 97% of CFAR crossings on raw $64 \times 64$ patches are border artifacts of the zero-padded detector. Second, on interior cells BAQ's clipping range decides detection: 8-bit BAQ keeps 69% F1 with tuned clipping but 17% at $\pm 3σ$, and at 8 b/cs or less adaptive FFT thresholding preserves more detections than BAQ. We close with an evaluation protocol for learned radar compression.

</details>


### [237] [A Mesoscopic View of Transformer Weights Through Row and Column Scale Fields](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35852)
*Tiexin Ding*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究了Transformer权重的"介观"结构——行/列尺度场（通道上的中位中心化log-RMS轮廓），揭示了权重的功能通道组织、跨投影对齐、RoPE频率重分配、训练动态及AdamW二阶矩中的类似结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 池化统计量掩盖了权重幅度在功能通道上的分布，而单个权重数量过多无法直接比较。作者希望在两者之间的介观层面寻找可分析、可解释的权重结构。

Method: 将权重矩阵精确分解为全局尺度、行/列尺度场（中位中心化log-RMS轮廓）和平衡核心。在Pythia检查点（四种规模）和三种初始化族上进行测量，用混合桥模型预测池化形状偏离，并将分析扩展到AdamW二阶矩的log空间行列因子，最后通过编辑冻结检查点分离互易尺度平衡与相对通道增益。

Result: 不同检查点和初始化族呈现相似的测量核心幅度轮廓；混合桥能在留出运行和数据臂上预测池化形状偏离；索引场在共享功能通道的投影间对齐，query/key轮廓跟随重分配的RoPE频率；训练轨迹显示早期场形成后出现分量相关的拓宽或收缩；AdamW二阶矩中存在相关的功能组织；扁平化相对通道增益会增加分布内损失，同时保持矩阵范数和平衡核心。

Conclusion: 行列尺度场将池化幅度统计与通道组织连接起来，为追踪和检验训练后的权重结构提供了坐标系统。

Abstract: Pooled statistics of Transformer weights obscure how magnitude is distributed across functional channels, while individual weights are too numerous to compare directly. We study the mesoscopic level between them: row and column scale fields, the median-centred log-RMS profiles of a weight matrix over its channels, which together with a global scale and a full balanced core represent the matrix exactly. Across public Pythia checkpoints at four sizes and controlled runs from three initialization families, balancing reveals similar measured core magnitude profiles. A mixture bridge, with its form fixed before the analysis and its coefficients fitted, predicts the pooled-shape departure from field width on held-out runs and data arms of the controlled grid. The indexed fields retain further structure: they align across projections that share a functional channel, and query/key profiles follow reassigned RoPE frequencies rather than fixed matrix coordinates. Training trajectories show early field formation followed by component-dependent broadening or recession. Extending the channel-based analysis to AdamW's second moment reveals related functional organization in its log-space row and column factors. Finally, edits of a frozen checkpoint separate reciprocal scale balance, which preserves the forward computation, from relative channel gain: flattening the gain increases in-distribution loss while preserving matrix norms and the balanced core. Row and column scale fields thus connect pooled magnitude statistics to channel organization and provide coordinates for tracking and testing trained weight structure.

</details>


### [238] [Position: Let's Strengthen Verifiability If We Can't Enforce Reproducibility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35854)
*Samet Hicsonmez,Nermin Samet,Renaud Marlet*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场论文，指出机器学习论文中实证结果难以复现、代码往往不可得，并呼吁通过具体措施提升结果的可检验性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习领域大量论文依赖实证结果支撑其主张，但实践中结果普遍难以复现，且复现难度日益增加；同时代码往往不可获取，这严重阻碍了研究的发展。作者希望量化并分析这些问题。

Method: 作为一篇立场论文（position paper），作者对上述复现与代码可得性问题进行了分析与量化，并提出了旨在改进结果可检验性（即便难以完全复现）的具体建议。

Result: 作者对复现困难和代码缺失问题进行了量化分析，并给出了具体改进提案；相关代码与支撑材料已公开在 GitHub 上。

Conclusion: 作者主张提升机器学习研究成果的可检验性，并提供了具体建议与公开材料以推动该目标。

Abstract: In the field of Machine Learning, many papers contain empirical results supporting claimed statements or illustrating the performance of a proposed method. However, most practitioners know that (1) results are generally hard to reproduce, and increasingly so, (2) code is not often available to do so, and (3) it hinders the development of research. In this position paper, we analyze and quantify these issues, and make concrete proposals to improve result checkability, if not reproducibility. Code and supporting materials are available at https://github.com/giddyyupp/position-enforce-verifiability.

</details>


### [239] [Mara Chain: Rethinking Failure as a Stepping Stone for AI System Auto-Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35855)
*Yubin Lyu,Fu Li,Jiawei Fei,Yang Zhao,Weixing Mei,Yinan Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Mara Chain，一种将“被拒绝的候选配置”迭代精炼为后续优化“垫脚石”的方法，用于优化已部署 AI 系统的提示、技能、框架和代码等非权重工件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于 propose-evaluate-select 的优化流程只保留满足接受标准的候选，丢弃的被拒候选往往包含对后续优化至关重要的信息，导致后续提案反复遭遇相同的失败模式。因此需要一种能利用被拒候选信息的方法。

Method: Mara Chain 不丢弃被拒候选，而是保留它们，并结合前序尝试中累积的证据对其进行迭代精炼；每条精炼链限制为固定深度，并采用 Pareto 过滤的 Top-N 选择来约束候选池规模。

Result: 在 AppWorld 技能优化、TerminalBench 2.1 框架优化和 MuSiQue 检索流水线优化上，Mara Chain 以更少 rollout 获得更大任务性能增益。AppWorld 上相对性能最高超过 GEPA、ACE 和 SkillOpt-Lite 达 20.5%，相较 GEPA 以少 65.5% 的 rollout 达到目标分数；TerminalBench 2.1 上 pass rate 相较 AHE 和 Meta-Harness 分别提升 20.2 和 22.5 个百分点；MuSiQue 上相较手写检索流水线，测试 nDCG@10 和 Recall@10 分别提升 0.104 和 0.131。

Conclusion: 将拒绝候选作为可精炼的“垫脚石”并配合深度限制与 Pareto 过滤 Top-N 选择，可显著提升优化效率与性能，验证了保留失败信息对编辑提示/技能/框架/代码类优化的价值。

Abstract: Optimizing deployed AI systems increasingly amounts to editing prompts, skills, harnesses, and code rather than model weights. Existing approaches commonly optimize these artifacts through propose-evaluate-select procedures, where candidate configurations are evaluated and only those meeting an acceptance criterion are selected. Yet our analysis shows that discarded candidates often contain information critical for subsequent optimization. Discarding them causes later proposals to revisit the same failure modes. We introduce Mara Chain, a refinement procedure that turns rejected candidates into stepping stones. Rather than discarding a rejected candidate, Mara Chain retains and iteratively refines it using evidence accumulated across preceding attempts. The procedure limits each refinement chain to a fixed depth and applies Pareto-filtered Top-N selection to bound the candidate pool. Across AppWorld skill optimization, TerminalBench 2.1 harness optimization, and MuSiQue retrieval-pipeline optimization, Mara Chain delivers greater task-performance gains with fewer rollouts. It outperforms GEPA, ACE, and SkillOpt-Lite by up to 20.5% in relative performance on AppWorld, reaching the target score with 65.5% fewer rollouts than GEPA. It improves the pass rate by 20.2 and 22.5 percentage points over AHE and Meta-Harness on TerminalBench 2.1, respectively, and improves MuSiQue test nDCG@10 and Recall@10 by 0.104 and 0.131 over a hand-written retrieval pipeline.

</details>


### [240] [Beyond Keywords: Leveraging Generative LLMs and Label Aggregation to Classify Economic Policy Uncertainty in News Articles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35856)
*Paul Trust*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究利用大语言模型与弱监督技术，为公共部门经济监测自动判定文章是否涉及经济政策不确定性（EPU）及其具体类型，实现低成本、可扩展的多标签与层级分类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有EPU识别研究依赖关键词方法，易产生大量假阳性；或依赖机器学习方法，需要大量高质量人工标注数据，成本高、耗时长。

Method: 基于弱监督技术，使用生成式大语言模型通过提示（prompting）生成合成标签，并提出面向EPU相关文章的多标签与层级分类方法。

Result: 摘要未给出具体实验数据或性能指标，作者主要强调所提方法兼具成本效益与可扩展性，并可支持多标签和层级分类任务。

Conclusion: 生成式大语言模型结合弱监督可为公共部门EPU监测提供一种低成本、可扩展的自动分类方案，支持细粒度类型识别。

Abstract: This research describes the adaptation of Large Language Models (LLMs) for economic monitoring in the public sector to automatically determine whether an article discusses Economic Policy Uncertanity (EPU) and to identify its specific type. Previous studies either rely on keywords, which often result in a high count of false positives, or use machine learning approaches that require a large number of quality human labeled data that is costly and time consuming to acquire. In this study, we propose approaches based on weak supervision techniques, using generative LLMs to create synthetic labels through prompting, making the approach both cost-effective and scalable. Additionally, we propose methods for for multi-label and hierarchical classification of articles related to EPU.

</details>


### [241] [ReLOBGen: Replayable Limit Order Book Message Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35867)
*Junoh Kang,Kiseop Lee,Bohyung Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ReLOBGen 提出一种"构造即可回放"的限价订单簿（LOB）消息生成方法，在生成过程中即保证回放一致性，无需事后修正或重采样，实现100%可回放性并提升市场真实度与生成速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 闭环市场仿真要求生成的消息可被回放，但现有LOB消息生成器可能产生与当前市场状态不一致的原始消息。为修复这一问题，现有方法依赖事后修正或拒绝后重采样，这会改变回放消息的分布或增加推理成本。因此作者希望从生成机制上直接保证可回放性。

Method: ReLOBGen 在生成阶段即保证可回放性：首先从当前LOB的挂单中选择被引用的订单，然后生成与该订单及市场状态一致的其余消息字段。为选取真实感强的引用订单，方法从基于可合格挂单学习到的分布中采样，该分布由缓存的订单表示和上下文相关查询高效计算得到；随后通过掩码无效token 来强制其余字段的一致性。整体上无需事后修正或重采样。

Result: 在500条消息的rollout中，ReLOBGen 实现100%可回放性，改善了市场真实度（尤其体现在盘口顶层统计量和LOB消息的相对价格上），相比 LOBS5 基线每条回放消息获得 2.7–3.6 倍加速。

Conclusion: ReLOBGen 通过在生成过程中内嵌可回放性约束，兼顾了可回放性、市场真实度与推理效率，优于依赖事后处理的现有基线方法。

Abstract: We propose ReLOBGen, a method for generating limit order book (LOB) messages that are replayable by construction. Replayability is required for closed-loop market simulation, yet existing LOB message generators may produce non-replayable raw messages, i.e., messages inconsistent with the current market state. These generators therefore rely on post-hoc correction or rejection followed by resampling, which may alter the replayed message distribution or increase inference cost. ReLOBGen instead ensures replayability during generation: it selects the referenced order from the resting orders in the current LOB and then generates the remaining message fields to be consistent with that order and the market state. For realistic reference selection, ReLOBGen samples from a learned distribution over eligible resting orders, efficiently computed from cached order representations and a context-dependent query. It then enforces the consistency of the remaining fields by masking out invalid tokens. Together, these components enable efficient generation of realistic messages without post-hoc correction or resampling. In 500-message rollouts, ReLOBGen achieves 100% replayability, improves market realism, particularly for top-of-book statistics and the relative prices of LOB messages, and provides a $2.7\text{-}3.6\times$ speedup per replayed message over the LOBS5 baseline.

</details>


### [242] [Hybrid Ensemble Learning for EEG-Based Epileptic Seizure Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35876)
*Mason Dana,Khandaker Mamun Ahmed*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于EEG癫痫发作预测的校准混合集成方法，结合五个深度学习模型与三个经典机器学习模型，通过逻辑回归堆叠元学习器融合，并在CHB-MIT数据集上以严格留一患者交叉验证评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 癫痫发作预测需要在发作前提供可操作的预警，但患者独立泛化能力与误报控制仍是主要挑战，因此需要兼顾灵敏度与误报率的可靠框架。

Method: 构建混合集成模型：融合五个深度学习模型和三个经典机器学习模型，使用逻辑回归堆叠元学习器；流程涵盖信号预处理、手工特征提取、类别不平衡处理、概率校准及临床启发的后处理。采用严格Leave-One-Patient-Out交叉验证，阈值与后处理参数仅在留出的元数据上选择。

Result: 在过滤后的队列上（排除发作前期比例低于1%或高于15%的异常患者），模型达到74.2%的癫痫发作级灵敏度，每小时1.24次误报，平均预警时间16.9分钟。限定于目标误报预算的测试调优oracle模型达到60.9%灵敏度、每小时0.951次误报。

Conclusion: 该框架在患者独立条件下实现了较高的预测灵敏度与较低的误报率，并强调应同时报告灵敏度与实际误报率，代码已开源。

Abstract: Epileptic seizure forecasting aims to provide actionable warnings before seizure onset, yet patient-independent generalization and false-alarm control remain major challenges. We propose a calibrated hybrid ensemble for EEG-based seizure forecasting that combines five deep learning models and three classical machine learning models through a logistic regression stacking meta-learner. The proposed pipeline integrates signal preprocessing, handcrafted feature extraction, class-imbalance handling, probability calibration, and clinically motivated post-processing. We evaluate the framework on CHB-MIT using strict Leave-One-Patient-Out (LOPO) cross-validation, with threshold and post-processing parameters selected only on held-out meta data. On the filtered cohort, excluding patients with anomalous preictal rates below 1\% or above 15\%, the model achieves 74.2\% seizure-level sensitivity at 1.24 false alarms per hour, with an average warning time of 16.9 minutes. A test-tuned oracle constrained to the target false-alarm budget achieves 60.9\% sensitivity at 0.951 false alarms per hour, highlighting the importance of reporting sensitivity together with realized false-alarm rates. Our code is available at: https://github.com/DanaMason/IEEE-CARS-Hybrid-Ensemble-Learning-for-EEG-Based-Epileptic-Seizure-Forecasting

</details>


### [243] [From Static Policies to Adaptive Priors in Offline Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35880)
*Tianwei Ni,Vineet Jain,Akash Karthikeyan,Pierre-Luc Bacon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文主张离线强化学习的目标应从"直接部署的保守策略"转向"学习自适应策略先验"，即保留在后续在线交互中通过记忆、探索与自我修正持续改进的能力，并将该视角形式化为自适应离线强化学习（AORL）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统离线RL致力于在保守目标下学习可直接部署的策略，对数据集外的不确定性采取悲观处理以保证稳健性。但当离线策略随后经历测试时适应与在线微调时，这一范式显得不完整，因为它忽视了策略在后续交互中继续改进的能力。

Method: 这是一篇立场论文（position paper）。作者将新视角形式化为自适应离线强化学习（AORL），并将其与"离线到在线RL"进行区分；同时讨论以贝叶斯离线RL作为构建自适应策略先验的原则性方向，通过保留对可能环境的认知不确定性来实现。

Result: 论文论证了在分布偏移、数据集覆盖有限以及测试时条件变化的情形下，自适应性的重要性，并阐明了AORL与离线到在线RL的联系与差异。

Conclusion: 应将离线RL视为对未来经验的准备，而非静态部署问题；作者最后给出了相关联系、开放挑战与未来研究方向。

Abstract: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) has traditionally focused on learning policies for direct deployment under conservative objectives, where uncertainty outside the offline dataset is treated pessimistically to ensure robustness. We argue that this formulation becomes incomplete when an offline-trained policy is subsequently updated through online interaction, as increasingly occurs in modern intelligent systems through test-time adaptation and online fine-tuning. This position paper argues that, in such settings, the objective of offline RL should extend beyond immediate deployment and instead prioritize learning adaptive policy priors: policies that preserve the capacity to improve during subsequent interaction through memory, exploration, and self-correction. We formalize this perspective as adaptive offline reinforcement learning (AORL), distinguish it from offline-to-online RL, and explain why adaptability becomes important under distributional shift, limited dataset coverage, and changing test-time conditions. We further discuss Bayesian offline RL as one principled direction for constructing adaptive policy priors by preserving epistemic uncertainty over plausible environments. Finally, we outline connections, open challenges, and research directions for treating offline RL as preparation for future experience rather than as a static deployment problem.

</details>


### [244] [Learning in the Transverse Subspace: A Minimal Representation for Divergence-Free Operator Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35884)
*Yifei Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种对无散度向量场的最小表示：将 \(D\) 维域上的 \(D\) 分量无散场编码为同域上的 \((D{-}1)\) 分量场，利用傅里叶空间中的横向结构与 Householder 正交变换直接构造约化坐标，并让神经算子在该约化空间中学习时间演化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无散度向量场是不可压缩流和许多 PDE 系统的基本状态变量。现有冗余参数化（如 NCL 势）存在多对一映射：冗余虽能扩大等价解集、降低静态拟合误差，但无法为算子学习提供唯一状态，因此需要一种既能保持无散性又具有唯一可逆坐标的表示。

Method: 利用不可压缩性在傅里叶空间中的横向结构，通过 Householder 正交变换直接构造约化坐标，将 \(D\) 分量无散场表示为 \((D{-}1)\) 分量场。周期与封闭不可渗透场下该变换可逆、等距且保角；开放非周期流则用傅里叶延拓构造兼容周期场，并以最小能量准则选取唯一约化表示。神经算子完全在该约化空间中学习时间演化，推理时直接将 \((D{-}1)\) 分量场解码为物理无散 \(D\) 分量场，无需预测环境场或事后投影。

Result: 静态拟合与时间预测实验显示出依赖任务的权衡：冗余有利于静态优化，而唯一可逆坐标能为时间动力学提供良定义的状态。通过从学习状态空间中移除无约束的纵向或零方向，所提方法取得更低预测误差和更强鲁棒性，同时由构造保证无散性。

Conclusion: 冗余参数化适合静态拟合但不利于算子学习，而所提出的最小可逆约化表示在保持无散性的同时为时间演化提供唯一状态，从而在预测精度和鲁棒性上优于冗余表示。

Abstract: Divergence-free vector fields are fundamental state variables in incompressible flows and many PDE systems. Redundant parameterizations, including Neural Conservation Law (NCL) potentials, map multiple auxiliary representations to the same physical field. Our experiments show that this redundancy can reduce static representation-fitting error by enlarging the set of equivalent solutions, but the resulting many-to-one mapping does not provide a unique state for operator learning.
  We introduce a minimal representation that encodes a real \(D\)-component divergence-free vector field on a \(D\)-dimensional domain as a real \((D-1)\)-component field on the same domain. Exploiting the transverse structure imposed by incompressibility in Fourier space, we use a Householder orthogonal transformation to construct the reduced coordinates directly. For periodic and closed impermeable fields, the transform is invertible, isometric, and angle-preserving. For open nonperiodic flows, Fourier extension constructs a compatible periodic field, and a minimum-energy rule selects a unique reduced representation.
  Neural operators then learn temporal evolution entirely in this reduced space. At inference, the predicted \((D-1)\)-component field is decoded directly into a physical divergence-free \(D\)-component field, without predicting an ambient field or applying post-hoc projection.
  Experiments on static fitting and temporal prediction reveal a task-dependent trade-off: redundancy facilitates static optimization, whereas unique invertible coordinates provide a well-defined state for temporal dynamics. By removing unconstrained longitudinal or null directions from the learned state space, the proposed formulation achieves lower prediction error and greater robustness while preserving divergence freedom by construction.

</details>


### [245] [The Decision Value of Perception Compute](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35910)
*Hoang Pham Cong,Ho Viet Duc Luong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"感知计算的决策价值"概念，指出更优感知输出未必带来更优下游决策，并构建DEEP基准，以预算约束决策oracle评估升级式感知分配器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自适应感知通常在预期有提升的输入上增加计算，但当感知服务于下游决策系统时，更好的感知输出不一定产生更好的决策，现有评估以全保真推理为上界，忽略了升级可能带来的负价值。

Method: 定义感知计算的决策价值为输入从廉价升级到昂贵感知模式时下游损失的变化；引入DEEP基准，在选择性、延迟与能量预算下，对预升级分配器打分，并与预算约束的决策oracle对比，同时计入分配器自身计算开销。在KITTI、nuScenes（单目几何）和nuPlan（PDM-Closed规划器，开环，真实检测器输出）上评估。

Result: 34%-54%改变下游损失的升级反而使损失变差；有害升级在PDM-Closed规划器上也存在；nuScenes上感知增益与决策价值常符号不一致；按漏检感知增益而非决策价值选择固定可部署信号，平均使实际测试决策增益下降全部廉价损失的7.4%；学习型分配器能找到有益升级但选错（有害）比例接近随机，计入自身计算（20%延迟预算）后仅轻量路由器（约全检测器通过的3.5%）仍优于随机。

Conclusion: 感知层增益不能代表决策价值，应以预算约束决策oracle为参照评估感知计算分配；许多升级有害，学习型分配器价值有限且需计入自身开销，轻量路由器是当前较可行方案。

Abstract: Adaptive perception spends extra computation on inputs where perception is expected to improve. When perception feeds a downstream decision system, a better perception output need not produce a better decision. We define the decision value of perception compute as the change in downstream loss from escalating an input from a cheap to an expensive perception mode. Because this value can be negative, the allocation of perception compute should be judged against a budget-constrained decision oracle, with uniform full-fidelity inference as a baseline rather than an upper bound. We introduce DEEP (Decision Evaluation for Escalated Perception), a benchmark that scores pre-escalation allocators against this oracle under selection, latency and energy budgets, charging each allocator for its own computation. With deployed monocular geometry on KITTI and nuScenes, we find that 34--54% of the escalations that change downstream loss make it worse; harmful escalations also occur for the published PDM-Closed planner, evaluated open-loop on nuPlan with real detector outcomes. On nuScenes, perception-level gain frequently disagrees in sign with decision value. This mismatch has practical consequences: choosing among fixed deployable signals by missed-object perception gain rather than by decision value reduces realized test decision gain by 7.4% of the all-cheap loss on average. Learned allocators recover part of the oracle's value by finding beneficial escalations but select nearly as much harm as random, and once their own computation is charged at a 20% latency budget, only the lightweight routers, at about 3.5\% of a full detector pass, still beat random.

</details>


### [246] [Learn Now, Use Next, Trust Later: Prequential Test-Time Learning for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35911)
*Tong Zhao,Reed Li,Yuyang Hu,Yutao Zhu,Haijin Liang,Haibo Shi,Yu Lu,Zhicheng Dou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: StepLearn：一种非参数框架，将即时使用与持久信任分离，在部署中为LLM智能体提供及时且经验证的指导知识。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有测试时学习方法多从已完成回合中获取知识，反馈难以及时蒸馏以辅助下一步决策；而按单步转移粒度获取知识虽可减少延迟，但存在单回合内有效规则不一定可靠、等待验证会丧失即时收益、无限制复用会传播错误指导的问题。

Method: 提出StepLearn非参数框架：将信息丰富的转移转化为可指导下一步的假设，跨回合复用前需经过前瞻验证；在源回合之外的后续观测中检验其预测效果，仅有足够支持度的假设才可用于持久指导；整个过程更新外部知识，同时保持所有模型参数不变。

Result: 在WebArena-Lite和ALFWorld上经五轮实验，StepLearn配合GPT-5-mini平均成功率分别为59.9%和84.0%，配合Qwen3.5-35B-A3B分别为57.8%和88.1%；在四种设置下均优于最强基线EvoTest，领先2.2–12.7个百分点；学习动态显示优势不仅限于最后一轮，多数设置下首次任务尝试即已显现。

Conclusion: StepLearn通过分离即时使用与持久信任，有效解决了部署中知识及时性与可靠性之间的权衡，在多个基准和模型上显著超越基线，且优势在早期尝试中即可体现。

Abstract: Adapting large language model agents during deployment requires not only retaining past experience, but also turning new observations into timely guidance. Many test-time learning methods, however, acquire knowledge from completed episodes. Feedback from an ongoing interaction may therefore not be distilled into knowledge soon enough to help the next decision. Acquiring knowledge at the granularity of individual transitions could reduce this delay, but raises a separate challenge: a rule that is useful within one episode may not be reliable enough to guide future episodes. Waiting for validation can forfeit immediate benefits, whereas unrestricted reuse can propagate accidental or misattributed guidance. We introduce StepLearn, a nonparametric framework that separates immediate use from persistent trust. It turns informative transitions into hypotheses that can guide the next step, while requiring prospective validation before reuse across episodes. Their predicted effects are checked against subsequent observations outside the source episodes, and only sufficiently supported hypotheses become available for persistent guidance. This process updates external knowledge while keeping all model parameters fixed. Over five rounds on WebArena-Lite and ALFWorld, StepLearn achieves average success rates of 59.9% and 84.0% with GPT-5-mini, and 57.8% and 88.1% with Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, respectively. It outperforms EvoTest, the strongest baseline, by 2.2-12.7 percentage points across the four settings. Learning dynamics further shows that these gains are not restricted to the final repetition, with advantages already present on first task attempts in most settings.

</details>


### [247] [Replication Failure and Trivial Baselines in Road-Level Crash Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35917)
*Maurya Patel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 图神经网络在路段级事故预测中的增益不稳定：11项设计决策仅4项可复现，参考模型甚至不敌无参数历史计数基线，报告的领先优势多为基线回溯期过短的假象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图神经网络在路段级碰撞预测中应用渐广，但其报告增益的稳定性鲜有审视。作者希望独立重建近期一个不确定性感知模型的数据流程，检验其设计决策是否可复现，并考察其相对于朴素历史基线的真实优势是否成立。

Method: 独立重建该不确定性感知模型的数据流程，在伦敦三个行政区、采用扩展窗口协议，评估其11项设计决策，并进行多种子评估；同时用无参数基线（按累计历史事故数对路段排序）在匹配历史深度下与两个网络对比，并扫描基线的回溯期长度。

Result: 11项决策中仅4项在第二行政区复现，7项未能复现，其中4项符号反转；单行政区内某一效应在不同随机种子间符号反转，参考架构的每行政区种子波动高达35.7个百分点，而本文模型仅4点。匹配历史深度下，本文模型与无参数基线无统计差异（-0.90点，p=0.61），参考架构在18/18个留出窗口上均落败（-17.37，p<10^-6）。基线性能仅在回溯期上就从22.71%跨至83.94%，且该领域所有已发表数值均可由1至5年回溯期的基线达到。

Conclusion: 图网络在该任务上相对历史基线的表面优势在很大程度上是基线回溯期过短造成的假象。建议将回溯期匹配的基线与多种子报告作为最低实践标准。

Abstract: Graph neural networks are increasingly applied to road-level crash prediction, but the stability of their reported gains has received little scrutiny. We independently reconstruct the data pipeline of a recent uncertainty-aware model and evaluate eleven of its design decisions across three London boroughs under an expanding-window protocol. Four survive replication on a second borough; seven do not, and four of those reverse sign rather than attenuate. Multi-seed evaluation is decisive: one effect reverses sign between random seeds within a single borough, and the reference architecture exhibits per-borough seed spreads of up to 35.7 points against 4 points for ours. We further compare both networks against a parameter-free baseline that ranks segments by cumulative past crash count. At matched history depth our model is statistically indistinguishable from that baseline ($-0.90$ points, $p=0.61$), and the reference architecture loses to it on 18 of 18 held-out windows ($-17.37$, $p<10^{-6}$). Sweeping the baseline's lookback horizon shows it spans 22.71% to 83.94% accuracy on that variable alone, and that every published figure in this line of work is matched by the baseline at a horizon of one to five years. We argue that the apparent margin of graph networks over historical baselines in this task is substantially an artefact of the short horizons those baselines were computed over, and recommend horizon-matched baselines and multi-seed reporting as minimum practice.

</details>


### [248] [Normative Loss Landscape Navigation: A Trajectory-Based Approach to Mitigating Forgetting in Incremental Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35926)
*Isabelle Aguilar,Zayn Andre Zainal,Luis Fernando Herbozo Contreras,Zhaojing Huang,Omid Kavehei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出TMLN（轨迹调制景观导航），将持续学习形式化为弯曲损失景观上的最优控制问题，利用对角经验Fisher信息矩阵定义局部黎曼流形，并通过参数历史轨迹动态调制预条件子以缓解灾难性遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持续学习模型在非平稳数据分布上顺序训练时会产生灾难性遗忘。现有方法存在两大局限：预条件梯度方法较为短视；标准正则化方法使用刚性的标量欧氏惩罚，完全忽略了参数空间底层的黎曼几何结构。

Method: TMLN采用内存高效的对角经验Fisher信息矩阵（FIM）定义局部黎曼流形。为弥补对角近似的空间局限性，利用网络参数值的归一化历史轨迹动态调制预条件子，并将该基于轨迹的预条件直接整合进梯度更新中，从而主动保护历史上关键的参数方向，而不依赖加性惩罚。

Result: 在类别增量和领域增量基准上的实证评估表明，该方法显著降低了连续任务之间的损失障碍（loss barrier）。

Conclusion: TMLN通过将轨迹调制的黎曼预条件融入梯度更新，为持续学习提供了一种规范化的导航策略，有效缓解遗忘并平滑任务间的优化景观。

Abstract: Continual learning models suffer from catastrophic forgetting when trained sequentially on non-stationary data distributions. Previously, this has been addressed through weight regularization. While preconditioning gradients offer a promising alternative to mitigate forgetting, current approaches are myopic. Conversely, standard regularization methods apply rigid, scalar Euclidean penalties that entirely ignore the underlying Riemannian geometry of the parameter space. To overcome this gap, we propose TMLN (Trajectory-Modulatory Landscape Navigation), a normative navigation policy that formalizes continual learning as an optimal control problem over a curved loss landscape. TMLN utilizes a memory-efficient diagonal empirical Fisher Information Matrix (FIM) to define a localized Riemannian manifold. To compensate for the spatial limitations of the diagonal approximation, TMLN dynamically modulates a preconditioner using the normalized historical trajectory of the network's parameter values. By integrating this trajectory-based preconditioning directly into the gradient update, we actively shield historically critical parameter directions without relying on additive penalties. Empirical evaluations on class- and domain-incremental benchmarks demonstrate that our method significantly reduces the loss barrier between consecutive tasks.

</details>


### [249] [CADENCE: A Confidence-Adaptive Dual-Expert Network for Fast and Accurate Time Series Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35929)
*Onisa Mpaunda*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CADENCE：一种CPU原生的双专家架构，通过置信度自适应路由将确定性卷积岭回归专家与分布区间专家融合，在109个UCR数据集上以平均17.53秒/数据集达到0.8864的平均准确率，接近HIVE-COTE 2.0（0.8895）且无显著差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列分类存在精度与计算可扩展性的尖锐权衡：HIVE-COTE 2.0等元集成精度可达SOTA但计算开销巨大；MiniRocket、Hydra等超快随机卷积变换虽只需数秒，却在相位无关分布、信号运动学和类别数较大时的决策树碎片化问题上表现欠佳。因此需要一种兼顾高精度与CPU高效运行的方法。

Method: 提出CADENCE统一双专家架构，将表示学习解耦为两条路径：(1) 卷积线性专家，将10,000个确定性膨胀特征与闭式L2正则化Woodbury岭分类结合；(2) 分布区间专家，将竞争性膨胀核（Hydra）与跨信号运动学及FFT频带的二进Cornish-Fisher矩近似结合，用ExtraTrees集成拟合。内部验证元路由器带稀有类保留机制，动态选择纯专家路由或置信度加权的软融合，最后在100%训练数据上全量重拟合。

Result: 在109个等长UCR数据集、30次重采样（共3,270次运行）上评估，CADENCE总平均准确率为0.8864，位列档案第2，仅次于HIVE-COTE 2.0（0.8895，p_Holm=0.295，无统计显著差异），优于Hydra+MultiRocket（0.8818）、MultiRocket（0.8797）和HIVE-COTE 1.0（0.8786，p_Holm=0.048）。其将差距缩小至0.31个百分点，而双核CPU上平均每数据集仅需17.53秒。

Conclusion: CADENCE以CPU原生、低计算成本的方式，在精度上逼近SOTA元集成HIVE-COTE 2.0（无显著差异）并显著超越其他快速方法，实现了精度与可扩展性的良好平衡。源代码与评估脚本已开源于GitHub。

Abstract: Time series classification (TSC) exhibits a sharp trade-off between accuracy and computational scalability. Meta-ensembles like HIVE-COTE 2.0 reach state-of-the-art accuracy but require extensive compute, whereas ultra-fast random convolutional transforms (e.g., MiniRocket, Hydra) run in seconds but struggle with phase-independent distributions, signal kinematics, and decision tree fragmentation on large class counts.
  In this work, we present CADENCE (Confidence-Adaptive Dual-Expert Network for time series Classification Excellence), a unified, CPU-native dual-expert architecture. CADENCE decouples representation learning into two specialized pathways: (i) a Convolutional Linear Expert pairing 10,000 deterministic dilated features with closed-form L2-regularized Woodbury ridge classification, and (ii) a Distributional Interval Expert pairing competing dilated kernels (Hydra) with dyadic Cornish-Fisher moment approximations across signal kinematics and FFT spectral bands, fitted with an ExtraTrees ensemble. An internal validation meta-router with rare-class preservation dynamically selects between pure expert routing and confidence-weighted soft blending, followed by a full refit on 100% of training data.
  Evaluated across all 109 equal-length UCR Archive datasets over 30 resamples (3,270 total runs), CADENCE achieves a grand mean accuracy of 0.8864. This ranks #2 across the archive, surpassed only by HIVE-COTE 2.0 (0.8895, p_Holm = 0.295, no statistically significant difference), while outperforming Hydra+MultiRocket (0.8818), MultiRocket (0.8797), and HIVE-COTE 1.0 (0.8786, p_Holm = 0.048). CADENCE closes the gap to HIVE-COTE 2.0 to 0.31 percentage points while taking an average of only 17.53 seconds per dataset on a dual-core CPU. Source code and evaluation scripts: https://github.com/onisa-jr/CADENCE.git

</details>


### [250] [Multimodal Detection of Higher-Order Behavioral Constructs: Self-Compassion in Structured Reflective Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37148)
*Siddhant Jain,Dimitra Tsovaltzi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究如何在技术中介的反思性访谈中计算建模"自我关怀"这一难以直接观测的心理建构，构建了包含51段反思对话的多模态数据集，并提出基于时间窗口的视频-音频-文本对齐流程，通过简单概率级融合取得有限但稳定的性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多对学习与成长至关重要的品质（如情绪调节、反思挫折、对话中的共情感知）无法直接观测，需从个体的言语、动作与声音随时间的变化中推断，且难以进行传统机器学习所需的清晰标注。作者选取心理学理论根基深厚但极少被计算建模的"自我关怀"（self-compassion）作为案例，即面对自身挫折时以耐心而非严厉自我批评来回应。由于现有数据集无法覆盖此类建构与场景，作者希望在技术中介的培训环境中，通过结构化反思访谈来研究该建构的表达与建模方式。

Method: 1) 采集并标注51段反思对话会话，采用基于既有理论、独立且时间上重叠的标注方案；2) 将心理学中的六成分模型整合为三类监督空间，在自我友善与正念之间平衡自我批评或不堪重负的状态；3) 构建可复现的基于时间窗口的流水线，将视频、音频与文本对齐到统一时间线；4) 分别训练各模态的单模态模型，并与简单的概率级融合策略进行比较。

Result: 各模态单独训练的模型与简单概率级融合策略相比，融合策略相较于最佳单模态模型取得了适度但一致的性能提升。作者进一步分析了每种模态在何处成功、何处困难。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了此类建构在反思性言语中的实际表达方式，并为更有效地建模自我关怀及类似建构所需的条件提供了讨论与启示。作者指出简单融合能带来稳定增益，但整体性能仍有限，未来需进一步探索如何更好地捕捉这类难以观测的心理建构。

Abstract: Many of the qualities that matter most in how people learn and grow, how someone regulates their emotions, reflects on a setback, or stays aware of others during a difficult conversation, are not directly observable. They have to be inferred from how someone speaks, moves, and sounds over time, and they resist the kind of clean labeling that most machine learning pipelines are built around. We study this challenge through a case that is well grounded in psychological theory but rarely modeled computationally: self-compassion, the tendency to respond to one's own setbacks with patience rather than harsh self-criticism. We examine how it appears during structured reflective interviews in a technology-mediated training setting, where people naturally talk through socio-emotionally demanding situations. Since no existing dataset captures this kind of construct in this kind of setting, we collected and annotated 51 reflective dialog sessions using an independent, temporally overlapping annotation scheme grounded in established theory. We consolidate the underlying six-component psychological model into a three-class supervision space, balancing self-kindness and mindfulness against self-critical or overwhelmed states, and build a reproducible window-based pipeline that aligns video, audio, and text on a shared timeline. Unimodal models trained on each modality separately are compared against a simple probability-level fusion strategy, which yields modest but consistent gains over the best single modality. We close by discussing where each modality succeeds or struggles, what this suggests about how this kind of construct is actually expressed in reflective speech, and what would be needed to model it, and constructs like it, more effectively.

</details>


### [251] [Graph neural networks for sampling-invariant embeddings of organized signal sets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35934)
*Martin Bauw,Santiago Velasco-Forero,Jesus Angulo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究"组织化信号集"的神经网络编码器，目标是将异构采样的信号集映射到固定长度的向量空间，从而消除采样差异、支持任意拓扑感知处理，并以波形分离为核心评估其表示与判别能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传感器网络与雷达产生的信号往往是有组织的集合（有序信号、网格内的距离单元信号、或被视为图节点的信号），而集合内各信号可能具有不同的采样参数。这种异构采样阻碍了信号集作为整体进行统一处理，因此需要一个能消除采样差异的表示空间。

Method: 设计并研究用于组织化信号集的神经网络编码器，将异构采样的信号集投影到任意固定大小的向量空间；该表示空间旨在弱化异构采样参数的影响，使信号集可作为向量进行任意拓扑感知处理，且不受信号处理约束。实验仅基于合成复值射频信号，通过编码与嵌入判别实验评估表示的相关性，重点考察波形分离的判别潜力。

Result: 在专门设计以降低异构采样参数影响的表示空间中，评估了信号集表示的相关性，并以波形分离为焦点衡量信号集的判别潜力。实验全部使用合成复值射频信号完成编码与嵌入判别测试。

Conclusion: 该工作表明，借助神经网络编码器可以将异构采样的组织化信号集映射为统一向量表示，从而在消除采样差异的同时保留可用于判别（如波形分离）的信息，支持后续不受信号处理约束的拓扑感知处理。

Abstract: Sensor networks and radars can deliver signals as organized sets, e.g. ordered signals, signals describing range cells within a grid or signals perceived as graph nodes. Within such sets, individual signals may be characterized by distinct sampling parameters. This paper investigates organized signal sets neural network encoders. In the context of this work, the purpose of such encoders is to project heterogeneously sampled signal sets into an arbitrary fixed-size vectors space. This new representation space is designed so that signal sets can be processed as vectors rid of sampling differences to allow for arbitrary topology-aware processing with no signal processing constraints. Within this representation space designed to reduce the influence of heterogeneous sampling parameters, the relevance of signal sets representations is evaluated by considering signal sets discrimination potential with a focus on waveforms separation. The encoding and embeddings discrimination experiments conducted rely exclusively on synthetic complex-valued radiofrequency signals.

</details>


### [252] [KernelOnet: An Interpretable Neural Operator Based on Kernel Functions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35938)
*Yuan Guo,Hanshu Chen,Qiang Xi,Timon Rabczuk,Zhuojia Fu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出可解释神经算子框架KernelOnet，将核函数显式嵌入神经算子结构，使算子形式与边界型核展开方法一致，并在多个基准及浅水波导工程问题上以更少参数取得更高精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统神经算子如DeepONet通过深度网络隐式学习基函数，缺乏可解释性，且通用神经算子难以处理无界外域中的声传播问题。作者希望将核展开方法与神经算子结合，使算子结构具有物理可解释性并提升效率与泛化能力。

Method: 提出KernelOnet，用显式核替代DeepONet的trunk网络，并提供三类互补核：(1) 数据驱动可学习核，由神经网络参数化从数据学到的径向基函数，对常系数线性问题可视为非奇异基本解；(2) 物理信息核，将解析基本解等物理信息嵌入网络结构，使展开自动满足控制方程，可仅用边界条件无监督训练；(3) 混合核，按控制方程线性主部将解拆分为由解析基本解张成的齐次部分与由低秩学习校正核承载的源项部分，以平衡物理先验与数据拟合。

Result: 在三个基准和一个浅水波导工程问题上，KernelOnet均达到高精度；与DeepONet相当的情况下，以更少可学习参数取得更高精度；其无监督配置无需内部解标签；每次查询的推理成本远低于逐实例求解器。

Conclusion: KernelOnet为神经算子提供了可解释且高效的核展开路线，特别适合通用神经算子难以处理的无界外域声传播问题，兼顾物理先验、精度与计算效率。

Abstract: This paper proposes an interpretable neural operator framework, the Kernel Operator Network (KernelOnet), which incorporates kernel functions explicitly into the neural operator architecture, so that the operator structure matches the kernel-expansion form used in boundary-type kernel-expansion methods. Unlike traditional neural operators such as DeepONet, which learn basis functions implicitly through deep networks, KernelOnet replaces the trunk network with explicit kernels and offers three complementary kernels: a data-driven learnable kernel, in which a neural network parameterizes a radial basis function learned from data, and which for constant-coefficient linear problems can be regarded as a non-singular fundamental solution; a physics-informed kernel, which embeds physical information such as analytic fundamental solutions into the network structure, so that the expansion satisfies the governing equation automatically and can be trained without supervision on boundary conditions alone, with no interior solution data; and a hybrid kernel, which splits the solution, according to the linear principal part of the governing equation, into a homogeneous part spanned by analytic fundamental solutions and a source part carried by low-rank learned correction kernels, thereby balancing physical priors against data fitting on nonlinear problems lacking an analytic fundamental solution. On three benchmarks and one engineering problem in a shallow-water waveguide, KernelOnet attains high accuracy; where comparable with DeepONet, it is more accurate with fewer learnable parameters. Its unsupervised configuration needs no interior solution labels, and its per-query inference cost is far below that of per-instance solvers, offering an effective route to acoustic propagation in unbounded exterior domains that general-purpose neural operators struggle to handle.

</details>


### [253] [EnJoi: Ensemble Joint Score Filter for Generative Data Assimilation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35944)
*Julien Moreau,Marc Lelarge*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种基于扩散模型的数据同化算法，通过联合建模过去与未来状态并动态平衡当前状态与新观测的置信度，在稀疏非均匀观测下提升重建性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于Score的自回归扩散模型在数据同化中虽然能生成与观测一致的物理轨迹，但它们仅以先前状态为条件，未考虑过去预测的不确定性，导致置信度分配不合理。

Method: 提出新的基于扩散的同化算法，动态平衡对当前状态与新观测的置信度；核心是学习包含过去与未来状态的联合分布，从而可采用经典DA算法En4DVar的改进版本，利用粒子集合的协方差进行同化。

Result: 在流体与交通流仿真实验中取得更优的重建性能，尤其在观测稀疏且非均匀的情形下表现突出。

Conclusion: 通过联合建模状态分布并动态调整置信度，该扩散式数据同化方法有效克服了自回归模型忽略预测不确定性的缺陷，在复杂观测条件下具备明显优势。

Abstract: Data Assimilation (DA) aims to recover the full state of a dynamical system that is only partially observed. A solution is to use Score-based models to generate physically consistent trajectories that agree with the observations. These Autoregressive Diffusion models are trained by conditioning on the previous state; however, they do not take into account the uncertainty of their past predictions. We propose a new diffusion-based assimilation algorithm that dynamically balances the confidence in the current state and the new observations. Crucially, we choose to learn the distribution of the joint state containing both the past and future. This allows us to use a modified version of En4DVar, a classical DA algorithm that relies on the covariance of an ensemble of particles. Experiments on fluid and traffic flow simulations show improved reconstruction performance, especially in situations where observations are sparse and non-homogeneous.

</details>


### [254] [FluxLite: Inference-Time Proposal Control for Discrete Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35947)
*Yinuo Ren,Haoxuan Chen,Grant M. Rotskoff,Jiequn Han,Lexing Ying*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FluxLite：一种免训练、轻量的离散扩散提议控制框架，通过在预训练反向速率的稀疏有向图上对跳变率做稀疏扰动并用 q_t 加权的图散度项精确补偿，从而在保持目标路径的同时把残余重加权方差化为局部凸目标；实例化为 HEU 与 D-VCG 两个采样器，并提供群体稳定性与有限粒子收敛性理论证明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练离散扩散模型与扩散语言模型的多类推理任务可归约为从预训练分布的"倾斜分布"中采样。Feynman-Kac 序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）原则上能给出精确校正，但其权重在提议动力学与倾斜不匹配时频繁退化，增加粒子数带来的实际收益受限。因此需要一种能在不重新训练的前提下改善提议分布、降低重加权方差的方法。

Method: 作者提出 FluxLite：在预训练反向速率的稀疏有向图上，任何稀疏跳变率扰动都可由 Feynman-Kac 势中的 q_t 加权图散度项精确补偿，从而保持目标路径不变，并将残余重加权方差转化为局部凸目标。基于该原理实例化两个采样器：一跳局部重分配规则 HEU，以及在预训练速率基上的小规模非负二次规划 D-VCG。理论上证明了在标准 score-entropy 训练损失下的群体稳定性，识别出控制对分数误差鲁棒性的倾斜路径覆盖因子，并给出固定受控 Feynman-Kac 递推下的有限粒子收敛性。

Result: 在可解析求解的有限状态 CTMC 基准上，FluxLite 相对标准 Feynman-Kac SMC 基线将终端 KL 最高改善两个数量级；在 2D Ising 采样任务上，将行相关 MSE 的几何平均降低 5-7 倍，峰值处最高降低 55 倍。

Conclusion: FluxLite 提供了一种免训练、即插即用的提议控制机制，可在保持目标分布精确性的同时显著缓解 Feynman-Kac SMC 的权重退化问题，理论与实验均表明其能大幅提升离散扩散模型推理采样的效率与精度。

Abstract: Many inference-time tasks for pretrained discrete diffusion models and diffusion language models reduce to drawing samples from a tilted version of the pretrained distribution. Feynman-Kac sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) makes this correction exact in principle, but its prescribed weights routinely degenerate when the proposal dynamics are misaligned with the tilt, capping the practical gains from additional particles. We introduce FluxLite, a lightweight, training-free proposal-control framework for discrete diffusion. On the sparse directed graph of pretrained reverse rates, any sparse jump-rate perturbation can be exactly compensated by a $q_t$-weighted graph-divergence term in the Feynman-Kac potential; the target path is therefore preserved while the residual reweighting variance becomes a local convex objective. We instantiate this principle as two practical samplers: a one-hop local reallocation rule (HEU) and a small nonnegative quadratic program over pretrained-rate bases (D-VCG). We further prove population stability under the standard score-entropy training loss, identifying a tilted-path coverage factor that governs robustness to score error, together with finite-particle convergence for a fixed controlled Feynman-Kac recursion. Empirically, FluxLite improves over standard Feynman-Kac SMC baselines by up to two orders of magnitude in terminal KL on an analytically tractable finite-state CTMC benchmark, and reduces row-correlation MSE on 2D Ising sampling by 5-7x in geometric mean and up to 55x at peak.

</details>


### [255] [Intrinsic Associative Memory on Riemannian Manifolds: Curvature, Capacity, and Emergent Modes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35948)
*Krishnakumar Balasubramanian,Zhaoyang Shi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文在黎曼流形上构建内在稠密联想记忆，将记忆建模为Epanechnikov核密度众数寻求，揭示曲率是联想记忆的设计变量，决定其记住什么、创造哪些状态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 几何在此前研究中多仅作为约束条件，而本文将曲率视为决定联想记忆行为的设计变量，探究曲率如何影响记忆的存储、擦除与创造。

Method: 将记忆转化为Epanechnikov核密度众数寻求，在黎曼流形上构建内在稠密联想记忆；对比测地能量与体积校正能量，推导测地容量的标度规律，并利用黎曼均值漂移实现精确一步回忆。

Result: 证明测地记忆总能保留孤立模式，而校正记忆遵循尖锐的Ricci曲率阈值：正曲率在高维可擦除记忆，负曲率则强化记忆；给出保留所有模式时q_β^{-1/2}、典型模式时q_β^{-1}的容量标度；设计N模式配置可实现全部2^N-1个子集模式，随机数据仅得泊松数量；仿真验证曲率转变与所有设计模式，在WordNet名词层级上体积校正提升低容量检索。

Conclusion: 曲率是联想记忆的设计变量而非仅是数据的属性，为在流形上设计记忆系统提供了理论依据与容量标度及可构造策略。

Abstract: Geometry does more than constrain an associative memory: curvature determines what it remembers and which states it creates. We develop intrinsic dense associative memories on Riemannian manifolds by casting memory as Epanechnikov kernel-density mode seeking. We compare geodesic and volume-corrected energies and show that curvature separates their behavior. We prove that geodesic memory always retains an isolated pattern, while corrected memory obeys a sharp Ricci-curvature threshold: positive curvature can erase memories in high dimensions, while negative curvature reinforces them. We derive geodesic capacity scalings of $q_β^{-1/2}$ for retaining every pattern and $q_β^{-1}$ for a typical one, where $q_β$ is the pairwise kernel-overlap probability. We show how overlap \emph{creates} novel memories: designed $N$-pattern configurations realize all $2^N-1$ subset modes, but random data at the storage threshold yield only a Poisson number. We establish exact one-step recall using Riemannian mean shift. In simulations, we recover the predicted curvature transition and every designed mode. On WordNet's full noun hierarchy, we demonstrate that volume correction improves low-capacity retrieval. Together, our work shows that curvature is a design variable for associative memory, not merely a property of the data.

</details>


### [256] [ROSS: Relearning from Self-Generated Rollouts through Selective Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35954)
*Zhiwei Zhang,Huayu Deng,Fei Zhao,Jiayan Fu,Bin Liang,Kam-Fai Wong,Mu Chuan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 ROSS 方法，将历史自生成轨迹作为上下文并对选定片段施加监督，无需新采样即可提升模型表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型后训练依赖自生成 rollout，但策略更新后这些经验常被视为失效；历史轨迹虽可能与新策略兼容并保留有价值行为，却混有错误、废弃尝试和冗余动作，需细粒度选择性监督。

Method: ROSS 保留完整历史轨迹作为上下文，仅对选定的模型生成续写部分计算损失，实现选择性监督的离线 SFT。

Result: 在领域强化学习、多教师在线蒸馏和智能体强化学习中持续提升上游检查点，优于基线；Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 上六基准 MOPD 平均从 58.40% 升至 62.20%，SWE-bench Verified 从 64.20% 升至 68.40%。

Conclusion: 自 rollout 训练留下的可复用行为经验能通过离线 SFT 带来进一步增益，且无需额外策略采样。

Abstract: Large language model post-training generates self-generated rollouts through reinforcement learning and on-policy distillation, yet this experience is often treated as stale once the policy advances. Historical rollouts can remain compatible with a later policy while preserving behaviors that the policy no longer expresses reliably. However, they may also contain mistakes, abandoned attempts, and redundant actions that should not be imitated, motivating finer-grained selective supervision. We introduce ROSS (Relearning from Self-Generated Rollouts through Selective Supervision), which preserves the full historical trajectory as context while applying loss only to selected model-generated continuations. Across domain-specific reinforcement learning, multi-teacher on-policy distillation, and agentic reinforcement learning, ROSS consistently improves upstream checkpoints and outperforms baselines across mathematics, code generation, instruction following, and software engineering. On Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, ROSS improves the six-benchmark MOPD average from 58.40% to 62.20% and SWE-bench Verified from 64.20% to 68.40%. These results show that self-rollout training leaves behind reusable behavioral experience that can yield further gains through offline supervised fine-tuning (SFT), without additional policy rollouts.

</details>


### [257] [Making Cross-Continental Federated Learning Repeatable with FLIP: a Multi-Application Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36001)
*Rafael Garcia-Dias,Alexandre Triay Bagur,Chayanin Tangwiriyasakul,Virginia Fernandez,Parhom Esmaeili,Piyalitt Ittichaiwong,Yang Li,Lawrence Adams,Wason Buncharoen,Martin Chapman,Benjamaporn Chayanond,Sadthavud Chunrod,Tanawat Fongsri,Kass Gibson,Supat Plungprasertkul,Supawit Tangpanithandee,Kanyakorn Veerakanjana,Vicky Goh,Michela Antonelli,Joe Zhang,Kongkiat Kespechara,Sebastien Ourselin,M. Jorge Cardoso*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FLIP（联邦学习互操作平台），一个开源、多应用平台，将联邦学习流程拆解为可组合服务，并在英国与泰国的两个客户端节点上用合成胸部X光队列演示联邦微调与联邦评估，证明该平台可支持国际FL协作并提升可重复性、可审计性与站点自主治理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医疗领域的联邦学习（FL）面临主要障碍：每次协作都需重建治理保障机制，导致多数项目停留在概念验证阶段。作者希望提供一种可复用的平台方案来降低这类重复性开销。

Method: 提出开源多应用平台FLIP，将常见FL工作流实现为一组可组合服务：对站点结构化数据库的队列查询、从机构PACS按需检索DICOM、站点级项目审批，以及可复用的FL作业类型。在两个位于英国和泰国的客户端节点上，使用合成胸部X光队列开展两个用例：联邦微调与联邦评估。每个机构自行审批参与、在本地IT安全流程下运行自有节点。

Result: 平台成功支持了跨英国与泰国的国际FL协作，完成了联邦微调与联邦评估两个用例；结果显示该平台能提升可重复性、可审计性并实现站点特定治理。作者还提供了对现有平台的全面比较，以帮助研究者与运营者选择合适平台。

Conclusion: 本研究作出的是操作性而非算法性论断，不与集中式训练做比较（该问题建议参考现有系统综述与元分析）。核心贡献在于证明此类平台可实现国际FL协作，并改善可重复性、可审计性与站点自治治理。

Abstract: Federated learning (FL) in healthcare remains challenging, as the overhead of rebuilding governance guarantees for every collaboration stops most projects at the proof-of-concept stage. Here we present FLIP (Federated Learning Interoperability Platform), an open-source, multi-application platform that makes FL training and evaluation repeatable. FLIP implements common FL workflows as a set of composable services: cohort queries against per-site structured databases, on-demand DICOM retrieval from institutional PACS, per-site project approval, and reusable FL job types. To demonstrate FLIP, we ran two distinct use cases, federated fine-tuning and federated evaluation, on synthetic chest X-ray cohorts across two client nodes based in the United Kingdom (UK) and Thailand. In FLIP, each institution independently approves its participation in each project and operates its own node under local IT security processes. This study makes an operational rather than an algorithmic claim. It does not compare federated with centralised training; for that question, we refer the reader to existing systematic reviews and meta-analyses. The central result is evidence that such platforms enable international FL collaboration and improve repeatability, auditability, and site-specific governance. We also present a comprehensive comparison of existing platforms to help researchers and operators choose the right platform for their use case.

</details>


### [258] [Preferent Compression Bounds Are Tight](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36030)
*Dario Paccagnan,Marius Tirlea*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明了偏好式样本压缩（preferent compression）现有最优界是可紧的，通过构造基于均匀分布与次序统计量的实例达到该界，并给出更简洁的初等证明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代基于学习的方法部署的关键瓶颈是缺乏严格的安全性与性能证书。样本压缩是推导此类证书的有力工具，且对满足"偏好性质"（即学习理论中的稳定性）的算法有特别紧的界，应用于Scenario Approach、Pick-to-Learn、支持向量方法等。但这些界是否紧一直是未解问题。

Method: 通过基于均匀分布和次序统计量的显式构造，在极限情形下达到该界；同时提供一个只需初等计数论证、无需无穷维对偶性的更短、更易理解的证明。

Result: 证实了偏好式压缩的最优界是可证明紧的，即该状态最优界在极限下可被达到。

Conclusion: 偏好式样本压缩的最优界是紧的；并提供了一条更简洁且仅依赖初等计数技术的证明路径。

Abstract: The lack of rigorous safety and performance certificates remains a key bottleneck to the deployment of modern learning-based methods. Sample compression has recently emerged as a powerful tool for deriving such certificates, with particularly sharp bounds available for algorithms satisfying a so-called preference property -- also known as stability in the learning theory literature. These bounds find direct application across domains as different as the Scenario Approach, Pick-to-Learn, and Support Vector methods. However, whether they are tight has remained an open problem. In this paper we resolve this question affirmatively and show that the state-of-the-art bound for preferent compressions is provably tight. We establish this by exhibiting an explicit construction based on the uniform distribution and order statistics that attains the bound in the limit. Along the way, we also provide a considerably shorter and more accessible proof of this bound, requiring only elementary counting arguments and no infinite-dimensional duality.

</details>


### [259] [TORQUE: Optimizing What (not) to Quantize Before and After Rotation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36032)
*Ran Ben Basat,Michael Mitzenmacher,Shay Vargaftik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TORQUE框架，通过在旋转前后联合优化保留哪些及多少个高精度坐标，在固定比特预算下改进旋转预处理的量化效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 均匀随机旋转使归一化坐标分布近似高斯，便于使用离线优化码本，但旋转会将大坐标值扩散到多个坐标，增加量化误差。

Method: 在旋转前保留顶部k个大坐标以防扩散，旋转后保留少量最大幅值坐标以便对截断高斯分布使用离线码本；推导量化误差上界并证明top-k预旋转保留对每个k最小化误差，将子集搜索简化为对k的优化，使用离线码本和并行参数选择实现快速优化器。

Result: 在高斯模型下的数值评估以及最近邻检索、KV缓存压缩和激活压缩实验中，展示了重建精度与存储成本之间更优的权衡。

Conclusion: TORQUE通过在旋转前后联合保留高精度坐标，并利用误差上界证明top-k最优，实现了在固定比特预算下精度与存储成本更优的量化方案。

Abstract: Uniform random rotations are an effective preprocessing step for quantization: they make normalized coordinate distributions approximately Gaussian, enabling the use of codebooks optimized offline. We introduce TORQUE, a framework that improves on previous quantization works that use random rotations by jointly optimizing how many and which coordinates to preserve at high precision both before and after rotation, under a fixed overall expected bit budget.
  Intuitively, before rotation, preserving large input coordinates at high precision can reduce overall error by preventing the rotation from spreading their values across many coordinates. Likewise, after rotation, preserving a small fraction of the largest-magnitude coordinates at high precision allows the remaining values to be quantized more accurately using codebooks optimized offline for the resulting truncated Gaussian distribution.
  We derive a quantization error upper bound and prove that top-$k$ pre-rotation retention minimizes it for each $k$. This reduces the search over coordinate subsets to an optimization over $k$, enabling a fast optimizer that uses offline codebooks and parallel parameter selection for practical implementation. We demonstrate an improved tradeoff between reconstruction accuracy and storage cost through numerical evaluation under the Gaussian model and experiments on nearest-neighbor retrieval, KV-cache compression, and activation compression.

</details>


### [260] [Neural networks for spectral optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36047)
*Alexis de Villeroché,Beniamin Bogosel,Stéphane Breuils,Dorin Bucur,Jacques-Olivier Lachaud*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出两种神经网络模型，直接从区域几何预测微分算子谱，并用于基于一个或多个特征值的谱形状优化，精度高且能恢复经典谱最优形状。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 依赖于微分算子谱的泛函优化通常需要PDE求解器，计算代价高昂。作者希望用神经网络代理模型直接从几何学习谱，从而高效、可微地进行谱形状优化。

Method: 提出两种表示：一是用傅里叶系数编码区域并接轻量MLP，适用于星形几何，通过系数重缩放满足特征值缩放律，并对旋转和反射输出取平均以实现不变性；二是输入landscape函数、指示函数及其梯度，用Gram-Schmidt过程输出正交特征函数及对应特征值。

Result: 傅里叶+MLP模型在星形几何上精度达0.2%；landscape模型对前十个特征值的平均相对误差为1%，优于FNO的4%，用SDF替换landscape会恶化预测和优化误差；模型可从合成形状泛化到经典图像数据集域。

Conclusion: 两种代理模型都能给出准确且可微的特征值估计，可恢复经典谱最优形状（如第一特征值的圆盘及高阶特征值的猜想极小值），证实其可用于涉及谱量的形状优化问题。

Abstract: Given a functional dependent on the spectrum of a differential operator, we address the problem of finding a domain which optimizes this functional. PDE solvers might be used to tackle this optimization. It is however computationally expensive. We propose two neural network models which learn the spectrum directly from the geometry of the domain and can be used to optimize the domain from one or more eigenvalues. We investigate two representations. The first encodes the domain through Fourier coefficients and a light MLP, which is efficient on star-shaped geometries, achieving a precision of 0.2\%. Through a rescaling of the coefficients the designed models satisfy the scaling law of the eigenvalues. Additionally, averaging the outputs of the trained surrogates over rotations and reflections induces invariance for these transformations. The second is a model that takes the landscape function, the indicator function and the gradient of the landscape function. A Gram-Schmidt process produces orthogonal eigenfunctions as output of the model along with the associated eigenvalues. The landscape model reaches 1\% mean relative error on the first ten eigenvalues, compared with 4\% for an FNO model. Replacing the landscape by an SDF worsened both prediction and optimization errors. The trained model also generalizes from synthetic shapes to domains given as classical image dataset. The resulting surrogates of both approaches recover classical spectral optima such as the disk for the first eigenvalue or the conjectured minima of higher eigenvalues. This confirms that our models produce accurate differentiable estimates of eigenvalues, which can be used in shape optimization problems involving spectral quantities.

</details>


### [261] [Improving scalable oversight with co-trained monitors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36049)
*Joseph H. Rudoler,Kevin Tan,Benedict Tessler,Timothy Kong,Enric Boix Adserà*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究worker-monitor监督中监控器被规避的问题，提出联合训练监控器（监督与自监督两种方法），并给出理论刻画与实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: worker-monitor机制是AI监督的有前景方法，但针对固定监控器训练worker会激励其规避监控，导致监控失效。作者希望研究通过让监控器与worker联合训练（co-training）是否可避免这一失败模式。

Method: 1）监督设定下证明刻画：当且仅当可能监控函数类具有有限Littlestone维数时，才能以实现消失误差和查询率进行监控，将worker监控与对抗在线学习文献联系起来。2）自监督设定下提出基于测试时蒸馏的联合训练流程：监控器利用额外测试时算力生成训练标签，再把标准算力策略训练在这些标签上；对多数投票标签给出自适应worker分布下的有限样本锐化保证（含动作覆盖）。3）在代码安全场景中进行压力测试，worker被对抗训练以欺骗监控器。

Result: 理论方面：得到监督监控可行性的Littlestone维数刻画，以及自适应分布下多数投票标签的收敛（锐化）保证，说明监控器判决收敛到初始众数判决。实验方面：在代码安全对抗场景下，自适应监控器更能跟上不断演化的worker策略，而固定监控器更易被规避。

Conclusion: 联合训练监控器可缓解固定监控器被规避的问题；理论上监督可行性由有限Littlestone维数精确刻画，自监督测试时蒸馏在动作覆盖下具有收敛保证；实证表明自适应监控器在对抗演化环境中优于固定监控器。

Abstract: Worker-monitor setups are a promising approach to AI oversight, but training workers against fixed monitors can incentivize monitor evasion. We study whether this failure mode can be avoided by co-training the monitor alongside the worker, and explore both supervised and self-supervised approaches. In the supervised setting, we prove a characterization: monitoring is possible with vanishing error and query rates exactly when the class of possible monitor functions has finite Littlestone dimension. This connects worker monitoring with an established literature on adversarial online learning. For self-supervision, we propose a co-training procedure based on test-time distillation: the monitor uses additional test-time compute to generate training labels, then trains its standard-compute policy on those labels. For majority-vote labels, we give a finite-sample sharpening guarantee under adaptive worker distributions with action coverage, that shows that the monitor's verdicts converge to its initial modal verdicts. We stress-test the former in code-security settings where the worker is trained adversarially to fool the monitor. Our results suggest that adaptive monitors are better at keeping pace with evolving worker strategies, while fixed monitors are more vulnerable to evasion.

</details>


### [262] [ABC: Advantage-Based Control Variates for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36058)
*Hsiao-Ru Pan,Florent Draye,Bernhard Schölkopf*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文重新审视轨迹级控制变量，提出基于优势的控制变量（ABC）公式，揭示了其与直接优势估计（DAE）中回报分解的协方差结构联系，并将二者结合为单一actor-critic算法，在RLVR离线到在线设置下验证，数学推理任务中以更少在线优化步数达到与GRPO竞争力相当的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR中简单的无critic策略梯度方法（如GRPO）表现有效，而actor-critic方法依赖学习值函数，其近似误差会通过时序差分等优势估计器引入偏差。作者受此观察驱动，希望改进actor-critic中的优势估计以降低偏差。

Method: 通过优势-价值公式重新审视轨迹级控制变量，提出Advantage-Based Control Variates（ABC）；发现其协方差结构与Direct Advantage Estimation（DAE）的回报分解密切相关；将ABC与DAE结合为单一actor-critic算法，在离线到在线RLVR设置中评估，critic先在已收集轨迹上训练，并在在线学习过程中自适应。

Result: 在数学推理任务上，ABC使用显著更少的在线优化步数，取得了与GRPO具有竞争力的性能。

Conclusion: ABC公式为actor-critic提供了一种更有效的控制变量途径，与DAE结合后在RLVR中展现出较高样本/优化效率，表明改进优势估计可成为无critic方法的有力替代。

Abstract: Recent progress in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has highlighted the effectiveness of simple critic-free policy-gradient methods such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). In contrast, actor-critic methods rely on learned value functions whose approximation error can introduce bias through commonly used advantage estimators such as temporal-difference error. Motivated by this observation, we revisit trajectory-level control variates through an advantage-value formulation, which we call Advantage-Based Control Variates (ABC). This formulation reveals that the covariance structure is closely related to the return decomposition used in Direct Advantage Estimation (DAE).
